## HERA — Step 4: Landau fan, electron side, D = 0 (`landau-fan-vti`, `tetralayer-stacking-fs-count` Step 4)

> **05:26** · Landau fan e-side D=0: n +3.2->+1.2e12 (43), B 1.0->10 T uniform-1/B (91 rows), fast\_delay 3.0 s (10 tau), sr1 50 uV; ends 10 T, gates parked · **ETA ~10:16** (≈4h50m)

**Why this fan.** Spot check run 6 (n = +3.2×10¹²) shows tones at ≈ 7.3 / 22.3 / 29.4 T (ana, runs 6–7). At a single density they read either as an ABAB pair plus a sum tone at F_L (scale ≈ 0.90) or as a harmonic comb on 7.3 T. The heavy/light ratio sits near 3×, exactly the trap the investigation names. **The density dependence decides.** A harmonic tracks k·f₁(n). The ABAB heavy tone runs at ≈ 0.7× the F_L slope and climbs toward ≈ 0.95 F_L at low n. An ABCA singleton, or the sum tone, stays at F_L(n). The fan is electron-side because only that side reaches the |n| ≳ 2–3×10¹² design densities. The hole side of D = 0 stops at −1.27×10¹² at the TG limit, in the near-CNP exception regime; run 7 is its preview.

**Design, floored per `landau-fan` step 1:**
- **n window: +3.2 → +1.2×10¹², 43 pts.** n_max = 3.2 sits at the TG validator edge. n_min = 1.2 gives a 2×10¹² lever arm, so the heavy-vs-harmonic slopes separate by ≈ 3–4 δF. dn = 0.0476 is the ray-Nyquist floor (≥ 2 pts per Landau ray) at B_lo.
- **Field: 1.0 → 10 T, uniform in 1/B, 91 rows.** d(1/B) = 0.0100 ≤ 1/(3·F_L(3.2)).
  - B_lo = 1.0 T is `sdh_onset`'s onset_b on run 6. It is censored at the 10 mT record edge, so it is a lower bound. It is also what the investigation's ≥ 5-period rule needs for the 7.3 T partner: B_lo ≤ 1.27 T; this gives 6.6 periods.
  - B_max = 10 T, the session cap. It gives the widest window for the mandatory F_L-tone-origin B-window split, and parks the magnet where the LK step rides down from.
- **Settling: fast_delay 3.0 s = 10τ** (τ = 0.3 s, 24 dB/oct). This inherits the spot check's settling; it is not shaved, because under-settling on a fan's fast axis kills the high-F tones (STYLE burn #8).
- **Sensitivity: 50 µV = 5 kΩ full scale**, the spot-check scale. Worst corner is R(n = 1.2, 10 T) ≈ 105 Ω (run 5) × ~10 MR (run 6) ≈ 1 kΩ ≈ 0.2 FS.

**Price.** Measured, not inherited. Per point = fast_delay + 0.10 s of reads (run 5: 1.10 s at fast_delay 1.0). Per row: +3 s magnet settle (run 6), +3 s slow_delay, +1.6 s flyback.
- Grid: 3913 pts × 3.1 s = 3h22m.
- Row overhead: 91 × 7.6 s = 12 min.
- Ramp 1 → 10 T: 66 min. Positioning 0 → 1 T: 7 min.
- **Total ≈ 4h50m**, ending at 10 T with the gates parked at 0.

**Coverage trade.** Electron side and D = 0 only. The hole side is excluded because it is validator-limited to the exception regime. The low-n light partner (< 3 T for n < 2) is not resolvable in any window this rig reaches; the claim rides on the heavy tone and the F_L-tone trajectory.

**Checkpoints.**
1. **First rows** (B = 1.00–1.02 T, ~15 min in, after the 7 min positioning). Check: sr1 fs < 0.5, R(n) near the run-5 anchors (55 → 105 Ω plus 1 T MR), drain ≈ 9.9 nA, no leak beyond the known flyback transient, T at base. Rail or dead channel means abort.
2. **Row ~30** (B ≈ 1.4 T, ~1h45m in). Look for oscillations emerging across n.
3. **Row ~60** (B ≈ 2.5 T, ~3h15m in). Interim per-column FFT on the landed 1.0–2.5 T record (δF ≈ 1.7 T): heavy tone vs F_L across n. Continue, or abandon if nothing has appeared.

Guards trip on gate leak > 1 nA and on T > 2.5 K for 3 consecutive points.

# === Landau fan (`landau-fan-vti`), electron side, D = 0: n +3.2 -> +1.2e12 (43 pts) x B 1.0 -> 10 T uniform-1/B (91 rows) ===
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
N_HI, N_LO, N_N = 3.2, 1.2, 43            # 1e12 cm^-2; dn = 0.0476 <= ray-Nyquist/2 at B_lo (0.0967e12/T x 1.0 T / 2)
B_LO, B_HI, N_B = 1.0, 10.0, 91           # d(1/B) = 0.0100 <= 1/(3 F_L(3.2e12) = 3 x 33.1 T)
FAST_DELAY, SLOW_DELAY = 3.0, 3.0         # 10 tau at tau 0.3 s / 24 dB (= spot-check settling); slow: post-flyback settle
I_TRIP, T_TRIP = 1e-9, 2.5                # A (gate leak), K (fridge-event guard, 3 consecutive pts)

ns = np.linspace(N_HI, N_LO, N_N); Ds = np.zeros_like(ns)
Vtgs, Vbgs = calc_gate_voltages(ns, Ds, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert Vtgs.min() >= TG_MIN and Vtgs.max() <= TG_MAX and Vbgs.min() >= BG_MIN and Vbgs.max() <= BG_MAX, (Vtgs[[0, -1]], Vbgs[[0, -1]])
B_vec = field_invB(B_LO, B_HI, N_B)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP and B_vec.min() > 0
print(f"fast: n {ns[0]:+.2f} -> {ns[-1]:+.2f}e12 ({N_N} pts, dn {abs(ns[1]-ns[0]):.4f}); Vtg {Vtgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vtgs[-1]:+.4f}, Vbg {Vbgs[0]:+.4f} -> {Vbgs[-1]:+.4f} V; "
      f"D roundtrip max |D| = {np.abs(calc_nD(Vtgs, Vbgs, CAL['c_tg'], CAL['c_bg'], CAL['n_offset'], CAL['D_offset'])[1]).max():.1e}")
print(f"slow: B {B_vec[0]:.3f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.3f} T ({N_B} rows, d(1/B) {1/B_vec[0]-1/B_vec[1]:.4f} 1/T)")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _Tv, _B0 = T_sample(), T_vaporizer(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), T_vap = {_Tv:.3f} K (<2), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"heater ranges {heater.sample_range()}/{heater.vaporizer_range()} (0/0), PS {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and _Tv < 2.0 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert heater.sample_range() == 0 and heater.vaporizer_range() == 0
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
assert k_tg.nplci() == 1 and k_bg.nplci() == 1, "gate-current nplci not 1"
_amp, _frq, _tau, _slope = sr1.amplitude(), sr1.frequency(), sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"precondition drive {_amp} V @ {_frq} Hz (1.0 V, 13.777 Hz -> 10 nA); sr1 tau {_tau} s / {_slope} dB (0.3 / 24: dwell {FAST_DELAY} s = {FAST_DELAY/_tau:.0f} tau); "
      f"sr0 sens {sr0.sensitivity()} V, tau {sr0.time_constant()} s")
assert abs(_amp - 1.0) < 1e-3 and abs(_frq - 13.777) < 0.01 and abs(_tau - 0.3) < 1e-6 and _slope == 24

# Fixed sensitivity for the whole fan (no autorange): 50 uV = 5 kOhm FS at 10 nA — the spot-check scale; worst corner
# R(n=1.2, 10 T) ~ 105 Ohm x ~10 MR ~ 1 kOhm (0.2 FS), 2x QH-peak margin still < 0.5 FS. (state0 restore left it at 2 uV.)
sr1.sensitivity(50e-6)
print(f"sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (5 kOhm FS)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"landau-fan-vti (tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4): electron side D = 0, n {N_HI:+.2f} -> {N_LO:+.2f}e12 ({N_N}), "
                  f"B {B_LO} -> {B_HI} T uniform-1/B ({N_B}), fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s, sr1 50 uV, run-5 cal")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('landau-fan-vti')
s.add_comment(f'D = 0 V/nm, n = {N_HI:+.2f} to {N_LO:+.2f}e12 cm^-2 ({N_N} pts, dn {abs(ns[1]-ns[0]):.4f}), B = {B_LO} to {B_HI} T uniform-1/B '
              f'({N_B} rows, d(1/B) 0.0100); fast_delay {FAST_DELAY} s (10 tau), slow_delay {SLOW_DELAY} s; sr1 50 uV; '
              f'cal run 5: c_tg {CAL["c_tg"]:.3e}, c_bg {CAL["c_bg"]:.3e}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.4f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}; '
              f'investigation tetralayer-stacking-fs-count Step 4 (per-column FFT, F(n) vs F_L)')

# --- position: field first (gates parked at 0; blocking ~7 min), then gates to the first n point ---
magnet.field(B_vec[0])
print(f"positioned: B = {magnet.field():+.4f} T")
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbgs[0]); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtgs[0])
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, magnet_field, k_tg_volt, k_bg_volt, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
